idea: Week two, from the story bank: written from the tables, then corrected by two independent editors before voicing.
description: In rural Kerala, 84.6% of women aged 15 to 49 had 10 or more years of schooling in NFHS-6 (2023-24). That is above the figure for urban women in every other state or UT with data (the next is Himachal Pradesh, 78.0%). For all Kerala women the figure was 86.6%, the highest of 34 ranked states and UTs; in NFHS-5 it was 77.0%.
Survey estimates. Blank: Manipur (no NFHS-6 fact sheet yet) and Lakshadweep (small sample). The table shows how much, not why.
source: International Institute for Population Sciences, National Family Health Survey: NFHS-6 (2023-24) state fact sheets (total, urban and rural columns), which also print the NFHS-5 (2019-21) figure. Indicator: women aged 15 to 49 with 10 or more years of schooling. 34 states and UTs with data; Lakshadweep (small sample) is not ranked and Manipur has no NFHS-6 sheet yet.
